site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer mu'rkechi reñma dewman zugun mu'rkechi tekn'oloxia mew. Ngelay kiñe rangiñ servidor. Ngelay kiñe wenu kishu kishumkeechi.

hero.description: Dewman zugun mu'rkechi tekn'oloxia mew. Ngelay kiñe rangiñ servidor. Ngelay kiñe wenu kishu kishumkeechi.

about.title: Inche
about.intro: {project} kiñe pichikepu plataforma peer-to-peer mu'rkechi reñma, dewman zugun mu'rkechi tekn'oloxia mew. Trekanmu kiñe küme inarume interfaz kiñe ñidol kümeche kishu kishumkeechi arquitektura, kümelu kake ka pengelmekey mu'rkechi reñma ngelaytulay kiñe rangiñ ñizolfilu. Tüfachi proyekto kiñe open source, wülnge'l mew {license}.

decentralized.title: Cheñma kishu kishumkeechi red
decentralized.description: Ngelay kiñe rangiñ servidor, ngelay kiñe wenu kishu kishumkeechi. Pu kelluwe pengelin ka naqümkey contenido kiñe ka kake mew, ngelaylu kiñe rangiñ índice, traketador o base de datos.

accessControl.title: Pichi pichi nütram inarume
accessControl.description: Itrofill kelluwe deway ñi kishu reñma ñi kishu reñma reglas mew kintusenmu. Ñi kake red mew, kishu zoy ñi roles definangelfui: ñizol, administrador, publicador, moderador ka inafülchemu. Eymi nieymi pichi pichi nütram tunten ñi pengelin, moderar ka naqümün ñi contenido.

ui.title: Reqle ñom interfaz kishu
ui.description: Lif ka külmen medios reñma interfaz, dewman üytun, televisor ka dispositivos móviles. Küme inarume teklado, ratón, gamepad ka kontrol remoto mew. Pu zoy kelluwe pengelin software headless servidor reche meu interfaz línea de komandos mew.

dataFormat.title: Che zoy zugun datos kümeche
dataFormat.description: Ti LISH datos formato dewman JSON mew, kümelu kake küme dewman, küme zugun ka küme kimün. Reñma tami contenido küme ka kümeche metadatos mew, itrofillkelluwe küme inarume.

security.title: Wenu kümeche ka kümeche
security.description: Itrofill peer-to-peer kuwün cifrazo, kümelu kake tami datos kishu küme tránsito mew. Pu kelluwe deway VPN ñi mu'rkechi anonimato. {project} kümeche tami wenu kümeche dewmaeyu.

crossPlatform.title: Mu'r plataformas
crossPlatform.description: Ti software niyey Windows, Linux ka macOS. Küme inarume kiñe küme plataforma mew.

download.title: Naqümün
download.description: Tuyenge {project} tami plataforma mew. Itrofill naqümün kintusenmu ka open source.

macos.title: Wenu kümeche pu kelluwe macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper rakizuamche aplikasyon ngelay firmazu/notarizado naqümtuy internet mew {error} kishu mew.
macos.runCommand: Naqümel DMG o ZIP, petu nülal aplikasyon, dewman tüfachi komando terminal mew:
macos.explanation: Tüfachi nentun atributo cuarentena ka aplikasyon kümey dewman.
